snippet.title: Teacade | Trailer | Tea pouring puzzle for iPhone, iPad and Android
snippet.description:
Slide the teapot along the rail, let go, and send each serving through gutters, glass tubes, portals, valves, a water wheel, switches and trapdoors to six thirsty animals. Fill every glass to its line, not over.

120 handcrafted tables in six valleys. Pastel, cosy and made for short sessions.

Teacade by Lianes8 Studio
https://lianes8studio.com/teacade
